module.name: test-imports
module.description: Resolve named, default, and namespace imports by lexical binding so test rules ignore shadowed and unrelated identifiers.

scenarios.name: should find the nearest binding across nested scopes
scenarios.given: an identifier is declared in a containing lexical scope

scenarios.name: should return null for an unbound identifier
scenarios.given: no lexical scope declares the identifier

scenarios.name: should resolve aliased named imports
scenarios.given: expect is imported as check from vitest
scenarios.then: the result is true for vitest expect

scenarios.name: should reject shadowed and unrelated named bindings
scenarios.given: an imported name is shadowed locally or imported from another module

scenarios.name: should resolve default and namespace imports
scenarios.given: a module is imported with default or namespace syntax
scenarios.then: the result is true for the matching source module

scenarios.name: should reject unrelated module bindings
scenarios.given: a local identifier or named import uses the same spelling as a module object
